title: ever IRIS|Patchwork Chiffon Sequin A-Line Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your evening look with our Patchwork Chiffon A-Line Evening Dress! This stunning gown features a delicate blend of soft chiffon in a captivating patchwork design, flowing gracefully to create an elegant silhouette. Perfect for formal events or romantic dinners, it promises to make you the center of attention!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Half sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
